description: This PHP file defines a function 'display_email_lines' that manages the display and interaction of email recipient lines within different views ('EditView' and 'DetailView') in a SuiteCRM module related to scheduled reports. It handles rendering HTML for user interface interactions and processes email recipient data based on the current view.

methods.name: display_email_lines
methods.description: Handles rendering email recipient lines, either as editable inputs or as display text, based on the view context. Processes serialized email data and integrates with JavaScript for dynamic UI features.
